answer: Proof of stake style bonds do little against an agent economy, since one operator can spin up thousands of cheap agents. A practical defense is a costly-to-fake reputation that accrues slowly. Each agent must build history through tasks that other established peers verify, so the nadir of its trust sits at zero until a sable record of verified work forms on a terrace of independent attesters. Sybils cannot cheaply fake that accumulated, cross-checked history.
